title: A sprint worker's flagged choices become gates before landing
goal: The kb-worker brief asks for choices the item's goal leaves open as recorded provisional gates with a recommendation, not report prose, and /kb-sprint run lands an item only after its gates are answered or provisional; the review then confirms them. Answers the SP-ufr3qnff failure where a worker's flagged --root choice landed unasked and came back as BG-aycs7kml
